text.tspan: Weekly Report
To:Tom Ulaszek
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Status Report
Date:August 6, 1992
Accomplishments
1.Created rough draft of DIAG-0002 to cover TOS ROM and Diagnostics not working when
revision levels are mixed. Gave copy to Toomey Freeman for review. 7/30/92.
2.Moved component engineering locked file into my office. 7/30/92.
3.Started compiling a list of control documents in my possession. 7/30/92.
4.Continued to develop an archive procedure for design documentation. 7/31/92.
5.Generated FAX to Israel for COMBEL, VIDEL, and AJAX Design information. 7/31/92.
6.Generated memo for criteria regarding design information that is to be archived. 7/31/92.
7.Generated a memo requesting a fire-proof cabinet for design information. 7/31/92.
8.Began layout and corrections to COMBEL functional description. 7/31/92.
9.Finished rough draft of COMBEL product description. 8/3/92.
10.Rewrite memos to Israel and for design archive criteria. 8/3/92.
11.Continued correction of COMBEL product specification to cover all revision B changes.
12.Completed COMBEL product specification with all changes. 8/3/92.
13.Backed up TT030. 8/3/92.
14.Sent FAX to Israel requesting information on COMBEL. VIDEL, and AJAX. 8/3/92.
15.Got extra information on production procedures for ST-Book from Scott Barrows. 8/5/92.
16.Circulated final copy of memo regarding archive design documents. 8/5/92.
17.Printed copy of Hardware Reference Guide done in Sunnyvale for Ira. 8/5/92.
